verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms an llms.txt returns HTTP 200 at airwallex.com/llms.txt, and a docs-level llms.txt is also cited. Doc pages are served as .md files, and Airwallex documents a developer connector that links AI coding agents such as Cursor, Claude Code and Codex to its documentation. Missing for 10: evidence of the llms.txt's depth or completeness (e.g., an llms-full.txt variant), and the root docs.md markdown endpoint returns 404.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: The Airwallex developer connectors connects AI coding agents — Cursor, Claude Code, Codex, and similar tools — to Airwallex documentation and the Airwallex sandbox.
